fit_reason: Whole private-party 1983 Chevy Cavalier convertible listed by owner.
findings: Dull, flat white paint on the hood and front fenders with spotting visible on the hood
Dirt and grime buildup along the lower rocker panels and rear bumper area
Faded, grayed black bumper rub strips front and rear
Faded gray body side trim stripes along the doors
Dusty-looking soft top with light gray fading on the black canvas
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the 1983 Cavalier convertible. The white paint on the hood looks a little flat and the black bumper strips have faded to gray, both things a buff and trim restoration would freshen up nicely before buyers see it. We do mobile pre-sale details and can come to you. Would you like a quote?
